packages.title: Native manifest producer / FMS native-v1 surface
required_semantics: native-v1 manifest discovery remains available to current consumers
manifest identity and discovery behavior remain deterministic
consumer-facing contract is preserved without carrying unrelated historical fork code
explicit_exclusions: historical commit replay as a migration strategy

packages.title: External plugin composition and admission
required_semantics: VCP_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_ROOTS / VCP_PLUGIN_DIRS / VCP_EXTERNAL_PLUGIN_ALLOWLIST composition seam
canonical path and realpath containment for admitted external roots
exact pluginName@sourceDirectory admission identity where applicable
external runtime registration remains explicitly gated
external plugin runtime environment remains sandboxed
external roots do not inherit plugin config env by default
explicit_exclusions: copying external plugin source into VCPToolBox core

packages.title: AGENTS OS Resident host integration contract
required_semantics: hybridservice/direct Resident host compatibility
pre-model fail-closed processing
ephemeral proposal presentation remains host-visible and not serialized to the model
non-enumerable presence binding and provider-attempt seal seam remain representable
provider body binding remains exact UTF-8 bytes
unknown OneRing authority metadata remains honest UNKNOWN rather than synthesized identity
missing or unadmitted Resident remains fail-closed before material provider execution
explicit_exclusions: vendoring a second Resident source authority into VCPToolBox

packages.title: Trusted Human authorization authority kernel
packages.canonical_formula: Trusted Client + Explicit Human Intent + Exact Pending Authority Target
required_semantics: self-authenticating trusted-client enrollment/proof rather than VCP_Key, deviceName or IP identity
durable trusted-client record and revocable session/capability admission
HTTP and WebSocket trusted-human admission remain fail-closed
approval receipt remains bound to exact pending authority target
tool execution consumes verified authorization rather than caller-asserted approval
unadmitted production profiles remain disabled and cannot be upgraded by payload/env spelling
explicit_exclusions: AdminPanel UI migration as a core prerequisite
automatic production admission of VCPChat or other clients
treating generic bearer authentication as Human Authorization

packages.title: Vexus Linux native ABI compatibility
required_semantics: linux-x64-gnu addon is reproducibly built from the exact accepted current upstream Rust/JS source
Linux GNU artifact respects the accepted GLIBC compatibility ceiling (<= 2.35 unless superseded by explicit evidence)
native addon load/runtime contract is validated on the supported Linux target
explicit_exclusions: copying the August binary artifact onto newer upstream source
pinning historical Rust source merely to preserve an old binary

packages.title: VCP-APP LightMemo / Cold TDB compatibility seam
required_semantics: knowledge_base remains the Cold TDB routing surface and folder remains Hot scope
cold_result_mode=structured remains available where consumed
cold_text_mode=preview|legacy_full_body compatibility remains available
preview avoids full-body expansion and preserves retrieval/order semantics
L03 candidate dedup remains a LightMemo pre-body/pre-rerank/pre-structured-seam operation keyed by library/source identity
include_river_trace compatibility is preserved where consumed
current upstream TDB storage/search/lifecycle is preferred unless a consumed compatibility failure is proven
explicit_exclusions: RiverMemoInspector implementation as a core migration prerequisite
forking TDB internals when current upstream behavior satisfies the consumed contract

global_exclusions: full-repository historical inventory beyond these six packages
wholesale cherry-pick of the thick fork
protecting historical implementation when only semantic contract is required

m1.name: CLEAN_UPSTREAM_BASELINE_AND_ACCEPTANCE_HARNESS
exit_conditions: branch ancestry starts at the exact current upstream commit
matrix contains exactly the six frozen packages
acceptance harness validates matrix identity and M1 boundaries
no product/runtime source is changed in M1
